input.description: Request body for creating a forecasting modelcard

usecase_id.required: one of usecase_id or usecase_name is required
usecase_id.description: Primary key of the usecase/project. Takes priority over usecase_name if both are provided.

usecase_name.required: one of usecase_id or usecase_name is required
usecase_name.description: Name of the usecase. Used for fuzzy/semantic lookup when usecase_id is not provided.

condition_one.description: Region filter (rgn_cd). Maps to conditionOne / region in the forecasting data.

condition_two.description: Facility filter (fac_id_cd). Maps to conditionTwo / facility.

condition_three.description: Unit filter (unit_id). Maps to conditionThree / unit.

user_id.description: ID of the user triggering the request. Defaults to the authenticated request user's ID.

outputs.trigger: Forecasting modelcard and PDF generated successfully for the given series/condition combination.

data.uue_text: Unexplained Unusual Event status explanation text
data._note: Additional keys from forecasting_pm.metrics JSON are merged in here dynamically

outputs.trigger: usecase_name provided but resolves to multiple exact-match usecases.

data.msg: Multiple usecases match the provided usecase_name. Please select one and retry with usecase_id.

outputs.trigger: Semantic usecase name resolution service is temporarily unavailable.
Neither usecase_id nor usecase_name provided, or usecase_id is not an integer, or name resolution returned no result.
usecase_id resolved but no Project record exists in the database with that ID.

outputs.case: Failure — No data for series/condition combination
outputs.trigger: The given series + condition_one (+ optional condition_two/three) combination does not exist in the forecasting dataset.

data.error: No data available for this combination. {'series': 'value_type_A', 'conditionOne': 'REGION_01', 'conditionTwo': 'FACILITY_02'}

outputs.trigger: An unexpected exception occurred during forecasting modelcard creation (e.g. DB error, metric computation error).
ModelCard object was created but PDF generation returned None (e.g. HTML rendering or PDF generation failure).
ModelCardPDF record exists but its file field is empty or inaccessible (e.g. storage backend error).

notes: The nested 'data' key inside the success response 'data' object contains UUE/FE/SR status colors and texts, overall risk, and any additional metrics from forecasting_pm.metrics. It may be null if metric parsing fails — the PDF is still returned.
A modelcard is reused within the same calendar day for an identical series/condition combination. Only the forecasting_pm reference is updated on reuse.
condition_1/condition_2/condition_3 in the success response are populated from the persisted ModelCardPDF record's fields, sourced from forecasting_pm.
